citations.claim: approach E (index 1) red with queue 85 and wait 201 at first violating step, exceeding limit 200
approach E still red with queue building two steps before violation
approach E already starved at mid-run while NS holds green

explanation: Actuated control with N/E/W detectors failed never sees EW demand and never sees NS gap-out correctly, so it holds NS green for the whole run. EW queues grow while red wait exceeds 200s, violating max_wait. Recall for long-waiting direction does not trigger when its detectors are failed.

violation.detail: approach 1 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The north-south approaches stay green from step 198 through 201 while the east-west approaches stay red. Blue vehicle queues on the east and west legs grow long and remain stopped, with the violating vehicle still held at red in step 201.
